controls.provider: existing serve.py canned extractor + loopback socket guard
controls.lifespan: off; isolates route computation; background workers NOT measured
controls.rate_limits: main.enforce_rate_limit disabled by serve.py; not all service rules disabled
controls.wire: real HTTP on loopback; decoded/uncompressed response bytes; no network shaping
controls.native_fields: default Items DTO; no extra Fields query
controls.users: one shared admin principal, web cookie/native token; six concurrent requests, not six independent users

audit_note: Synthetic route-computation experiment; heavily contended host, lifecycle/background workers disabled, not production or UI latency.
